top_signals.title: Oil Rises on Iran Attack, Korea Lifts Asian Stocks: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Crude oil climbed and Treasuries fell after fighting erupted in the Middle East, ending several days of calm and renewing concerns over disruptions to energy supplies. Asian stocks gained.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
